meta.name: ding
meta.description: Use for Ding-style (钉内/钉外) workplace reminders rooted in the 7.5万字 essay 《置身钉内》 and VP response 《置身钉外》. Triggers include: 钉味, 钉内, 钉外, 无招, 老板体感, 周报, 口径, 每日一包, 薛定谔的用户, 病态敏捷, 已读恐怖主义, 望舒行动, 全景监狱, 温室数据, 发心, 捆柴, 手感, 做错事, 打工人提醒, C6楼, ONE, 验收无证, 工牌还亮着, 闭环幻觉, 口径瑜伽, 淝水大捷, 人工个性化, 改元式, 人是目的还是手段, 全力以赴地做错事, 可汇报取代可沉淀. Do not use for pure coding tasks with no workplace/org/delivery context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成钉内/钉外职场提醒与段子
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常混迹互联网大厂，对组织行为学有共鸣。
copy.tagline_en: Generate workplace reminders and memes in Ding-style.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in a big tech company and resonate with organizational behavior insights.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在职场沟通中自动加入“钉内/钉外”视角的提醒，用原文梗（如“薛定谔的用户”）指出流程与真实结果的差距，并建议用证据替代汇报。
howto.when: 当用户提到“钉味”“周报”“口径”“老板体感”等 30 多个关键词，或讨论职场/组织/交付话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个周报有没有钉味。
say.note: Claude 会从钉外视角分析周报是否用证据说话。

say.text: 老板说可以了，但我觉得还有问题。
say.note: Claude 会提醒体感不是终点，需要验收证据链。

say.text: 这个项目内测数据很好，能上线吗？
say.note: Claude 会指出温室数据不可信，建议用正式环境验证。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude adds 'Ding-inside/outside' perspective reminders in workplace conversations, using original memes to highlight gaps between process and real results, and suggests replacing reports with evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like '钉味', '周报', '口径', '老板体感', etc., or discusses workplace/organizational/delivery topics.

say_en.text: Check this weekly report for Ding-style issues.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes from Ding-outside perspective for evidence.

say_en.text: The boss says it's okay, but I still have concerns.
say_en.note: Claude reminds that feeling is not the endpoint; verification needs evidence.

say_en.text: Internal test data looks good, can we launch?
